claim: Upstream asserts the Gregorian leap-century rule as compile-time constants: (2000/feb/29).ok() and (2100/feb/28).ok() hold while (2000/feb/30).ok() and (2100/feb/29).ok() do not, and it asserts the day-count arithmetic across the February boundary, sys_days(2100/feb/28) + days{1} == sys_days(2100/mar/1), sys_days(2000/mar/1) - sys_days(2000/feb/28) == days{2} and sys_days(2100/mar/1) - sys_days(2100/feb/28) == days{1}; these four are the direct upstream oracle cases for the era arithmetic's February handling.
